_doc: NGUON DUY NHAT cua design token cho ca web va app dien thoai.
Sua o day roi chay `npm run sinh_token` — dung sua tay hai tep duoc sinh ra:
`npm test` co test doi chieu hai tep do voi tep nay, quen sinh lai la test do.
HAI NEN TANG, HAI BO THEME (ke hoach v2 muc 4.5 chot nhu vay):
web    <- Metronic v9.5.0 (KeenThemes): Inter, blue-500, radius 0.5rem
mobile <- Compose Boltuix App Template: Be Vietnam Pro, #4285F4
Nhung thu KHONG phu thuoc nen tang (khoang cach, diem ngat, y nghia mau) de o ngoai.

diem_ngat._ghi_chu: F2: kiem thu bat buoc o <=768 (dien thoai/tablet doc) va >=1280 (desktop).

y_nghia_mau._ghi_chu: Trang thai nghiep vu -> khoa mau. Dung chung web va app de mot ngay 'du cong' khong ra hai mau khac nhau o hai noi.

_nguon: config.ktui.css viet theo Tailwind v4 (`@theme inline`) va tro toi bien palette cua
Tailwind (`--color-zinc-950`...) chu khong ghi ma mau. Gia tri hex duoi day lay tu
chinh tep demo — do la ban CEO da xem va duyet huong.

chu_viet._kiem_tra: Inter co 2.849 glyph, phu 133/133 ky tu tieng Viet — dung duoc (khac Poppins).
chu_viet._tu_chua: Demo nap Inter tu Google Fonts CDN. Ta tu chua trong repo: khong ro ri IP nhan vien, va chay duoc trong LAN khong ra Internet.

bien_thien._ghi_chu: Font bien thien: MOT tep phu lien tuc 400-700 (171 KB) — nho hon 4 tep tinh (180 KB) va do dam muot hon. Da cat truc opsz va gioi han wght de bo phan khong dung.

bo_goc._ghi_chu: Metronic `--radius: 0.5rem` = 8px (lg). sm = radius-4 = 4px, md = radius-2 = 6px, xl = radius+4 = 12px. Web KHAC mobile (12px) — dung y ke hoach: hai nen tang hai theme.

_avatar: Anh dai dien sinh mau tu ma nhan vien: JS chi dat --av-hue, con do bao hoa / do
sang / mau chu lay o day. Phai tach theo tung giao dien: da quet ca 360 hue va
KHONG cap (S, L) nao doc duoc o ca hai. Nen toi + chu trang: chu/nen 4.92:1 va
Dao lai: avatar SANG mau + chu dam. Quet 360 hue: chu/nen 4.67:1, avatar/the-toi
4.67:1. Giu nguyen cap cua giao dien sang thi vong tron lan vao the (1.35:1).

_lech_khoi_demo: Demo dat chu/nhan nut LEN mau primary #3B82F6 o 4 cho (.lnk, .btn-p, .nav.on, .tab.on).
#3B82F6 chi dat 3.68:1 tren nen trang va chu trang tren no cung 3.68:1 — khong du
WCAG AA. Nen tach vai tro giong ben mobile: `chinh` (#3B82F6) CHI to mang khong co
chu de len (gach chan tab, thanh tien do, cot bieu do); chu / lien ket / nen nut dac
dung `chinh_dam` (#2563EB, 5.17:1). #2563EB chinh la primary che do toi cua Metronic
nen van nam trong ho mau goc.
Nhan nhom sidebar cua demo dung zinc-600 #52525B tren #18181B — chi 2.29:1, doc rat
Badge cua demo (.b-green/.b-amber/.b-red/.b-blue) da dung ban chu dam san nen dat

mobile._nguon: Compose Boltuix App Template v1.2025.3 — Color.kt / Shape.kt / Type.kt da giai nen va doi chieu.

_ly_do_khong_dung_poppins: Spec ghi font Poppins. Da kiem: ca 8 tep Poppins trong kit VA ban chinh thuc tren
google/fonts deu chi co 471 glyph va THIEU 88/133 ky tu tieng Viet — mat o u va toan
bo khoi U+1EA0-1EF9 (a a a a a e e i o o o u u u...). Dung Poppins thi hau het nhan
tieng Viet bi tut sang font du phong, chu bi lan font ngay giua mot tu.
Be Vietnam Pro: sans hinh hoc, phu 133/133 ky tu Viet, dau duoc thiet ke rieng cho
tieng Viet, hep hon Montserrat nen vua o bang. Giay phep SIL OFL 1.1.

bo_goc._ghi_chu: Kit goc Shape.kt = 4dp. Mockup CEO duyet ~13px. Da chot 12px: lam tron tu 13, chia het cho thang 4dp nen the long trong the van deu.

_lech_khoi_spec: Mau thuong hieu #4285F4 khop Color.kt (`composeThemeColor = Color(0xFF4285f4)`) nhung
chi dat 3.56:1 tren nen trang — giong y van de cua #3B82F6 ben web. `chinh` chi to mang;
Mau nhan spec ghi #EB4658 cung chi 3.6:1 nen che do sang dung #C1273A cung ho.

bong._ghi_chu: Chi web dung. App dien thoai dung vien 1px thay bong cho nhat quan hai he dieu hanh.
